full_prompt_en: A square black-ink drawing shows a narrow water passage between high rocky cliffs beneath a moon and scattered stars. The near right cliff rises steeply from the water and occupies almost the entire right edge, its broken surface packed with short hatching and stippled shadow. A tiny cluster of towers and pointed rooftops sits at its upper tip. Across the channel, a thinner wall of jagged peaks runs down the left edge, leaving a wide opening of white sky between the two dark landforms. A round moon hangs in the upper left sky, outlined with a thin circle and lightly filled with crater-like marks. Small irregular stars and dots are dispersed across the open space. In the lower center, a tiny person sits in a narrow rowboat near the foreground, facing toward the distant gap. Farther back, an even smaller sailboat stands on the bright horizon. The water is drawn with many broken horizontal strokes; dense ripples near the foreground gradually compress into quieter, thinner lines in the distance. The light is imagined through the uninked paper: the sky and central channel remain almost white, while the cliffs grow dark through accumulated marks. Hard black outlines define the rock edges, then short scratchy lines model their texture. The composition draws the eye from the small boat through a tapering corridor toward the luminous distance. Sparse celestial marks balance the dense cliff textures and give the scene a whimsical, solitary storybook feeling.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑墨线画呈现高耸岩崖之间的狭长水道，头顶有月亮与零散星点。近处右崖从水中陡升，几乎占满整条右边缘，破碎表面由短排线和点描阴影密集铺成。崖顶有一小簇塔楼和尖屋顶。水道对面，更细的锯齿山峰沿左边缘伸展，两片深色陆地之间留出宽阔白天空。一轮圆月挂在左上，以细圆线勾边，内部浅浅绘出坑纹状斑点。大小不一的小星形和点散在开阔空间。下部中央，极小人影坐在近前景的狭窄划艇里，朝向远方缺口。更远处，一艘更小的帆船立在明亮地平线上。水面由许多破碎水平线绘成；前景密集涟漪向远处逐渐压缩为更静、更细的线。光由未着墨的纸白暗示：天空和中央水道几乎全白，崖壁则靠累积笔痕变深。坚硬黑轮廓勾出岩缘，短促刮痕状线条再塑造其肌理。构图把目光从小船引过逐渐收窄的走廊，通向发亮远方。稀疏天体笔点平衡密集崖纹，使场景带有奇想而孤独的绘本感。
style_prompt_en: A monochrome pen-and-ink drawing creates depth through the density of small black marks on white paper. Tall irregular contour masses frame a broad central opening, while a tapering lower channel directs the eye into distance. Short crosshatches, stipples, and scratchy strokes accumulate into deep shadow at one edge; fine broken horizontals spread across the lower field and become lighter toward the horizon. Small floating dots and tiny star-like marks give the open upper space a measured rhythm. The strongest light is the unmarked white paper itself, set against ink-heavy margins. Outlines remain crisp and hand-drawn, with uneven thickness and slight wobble. The composition balances richly worked texture against generous blank space, allowing a few miniature accents to establish scale and a quiet narrative mood.
style_prompt_zh: 单色钢笔墨画通过白纸上小黑笔痕的密度建立纵深。高而不规则的轮廓团块围出宽阔中央开口，下部逐渐收窄的通道把目光引向远方。短交叉排线、点描和刮擦般笔触在一侧累积成深影；细碎水平线铺在下部色域，向地平线变浅。浮散小点和星形微痕给上部空域以有节制的节奏。最强的光来自未落墨的纸白，与重墨边缘相对。轮廓保持清楚、手绘感明显，粗细不均并略有晃动。构图在丰厚纹理与宽裕空白间取得平衡，少数微缩重音即可建立尺度和安静叙事氛围。
